title: Pressure and wall shear stress from 4D-flow MRI, measured against Womersley's closed form
description: A synthetic straight artery with Womersley's exact solution, sampled the way 4D-flow MRI samples one: voxel centres across the radius (so the wall is never measured), 24 cardiac phases, 3 planes and 5 % velocity noise. An ensemble of axisymmetric Navier-Stokes PINNs -- no-slip, axis symmetry and periodicity exact by construction -- recovers the wall shear stress waveform to 1.2-7.0 % and the pressure gradient to 2.5-8.4 % of the closed form, where the two-point difference from the same samples is 27-100 % wrong. Four figures, a voxel-size sweep and a noise sweep.

metrics.name: wss_error_worst_single_harmonic
metrics.how: relative L2 over the cardiac cycle of the ensemble mean wall shear stress against the Womersley closed form, worst of the four single-harmonic phantoms (2-20.7 Womersley number, 8 voxels across the radius, 5 % velocity noise)

metrics.name: wss_error_physiological
metrics.how: the same, for the five-harmonic waveform at the aortic radius: four frequencies, the highest at alpha 41

metrics.name: pressure_gradient_error_worst
metrics.how: relative L2 over the cardiac cycle of the recovered axial pressure gradient against the closed form, worst of the five phantoms; the pressure drop over the studied segment is the gradient times ten radii

metrics.name: wss_error_two_point_aorta
metrics.how: the same metric for the two-point finite difference every 4D-flow pipeline starts from, on the 15 mm phantom: the estimator the network is being compared with

metrics.name: peak_wall_shear_aorta
metrics.how: the closed-form peak of the wall shear stress waveform, so that a relative error is readable in Pa

metrics.name: pressure_drop_peak_aorta
metrics.how: the closed-form peak of p(z) - p(z + L) over the studied segment, L = 10 radii = 15 cm

metrics.name: ensemble_spread_over_peak
metrics.how: mean over the cycle of the ensemble standard deviation of the wall shear stress (3 members), divided by its peak

metrics.name: ensemble_coverage_2sigma
metrics.how: fraction of the cycle where the closed form lies inside the ensemble mean +/- 2 standard deviations; 0.95 is a calibrated spread

metrics.name: stokes_layer
metrics.how: R/alpha = sqrt(nu/omega): the thickness of the oscillatory boundary layer the wall shear stress lives in, the same for every vessel at 60 bpm

metrics.name: wall_gap_aorta
metrics.how: distance from the nearest 4D-flow sample to the wall on the 15 mm phantom at 8 voxels across the radius: 1.3 boundary layers

metrics.name: wss_error_at_four_voxels_aorta
metrics.how: the same wall shear stress metric when the voxel is coarse enough to put the first sample 2.6 boundary layers from the wall -- the measured edge of the range

metrics.name: velocity_error_worst
metrics.how: relative L2 of the fitted axial velocity over the whole (r, phase) field, worst of the five phantoms: the field itself is recovered, not only its derivatives

checks.name: closed_form_satisfies_the_womersley_equation
checks.label: the analytic profile and its analytic derivative satisfy i w W = G/rho + nu (1/r)(r W_r)_r to 2e-6 relative, and the Poiseuille and quasi-steady limits to 1e-12

checks.name: no_slip_axis_and_periodicity_are_exact
checks.label: built into the ansatz: v = (1 - y^2) N_v(y^2, sin tau, cos tau), u = y (1 - y^2) N_u -- the network cannot trade them for a better data fit

checks.name: wall_shear_stress_within_5_percent
checks.label: worst single-harmonic phantom at 2.8 % relative L2 against the closed form, from an acquisition whose closest sample is 0.2-1.3 boundary layers from the wall

checks.name: wall_shear_stress_within_10_percent_multiharmonic
checks.label: the five-harmonic waveform at 7.0 %, with harmonics up to alpha 41

checks.name: pressure_gradient_within_10_percent
checks.label: worst of the five phantoms at 8.4 % relative L2 over the cycle, in the only form an incompressible field has a pressure: differences between two planes

checks.name: beats_the_two_point_difference
checks.label: all five phantoms, by a factor of 36 on the aorta and 23 on the small artery

checks.name: ensemble_band_is_calibrated
checks.label: FAILED as measured: the closed form is inside the ensemble +/- 2 sd for 29.2 % of the cycle on the aorta (and 21-29 % on the four single-harmonic phantoms), so the spread prices the seed and not the model -- it is reported as a spread, never as an error bar

references.text: Womersley J.R., Method for the calculation of velocity, rate of flow and viscous drag in arteries when the pressure gradient is known, J. Physiol. 127 (1955) 553-563
references.note: the closed form this whole example is measured against

references.text: Nichols W.W., O'Rourke M.F., McDonald's Blood Flow in Arteries
references.note: the rounded whole-blood values (1060 kg/m3, 3.5 mPa s) and the physiological flow waveforms
